description: Show or hide signed mold draft on the active part, in the part local frame. on true classifies every face, including fillets and blend faces, against the mold-analysis pull. The angle is the geometric normal of that triangle. A stamped face normal is one average and does not drop the face. Positive draft means the face normal points along the pull (the inside walls of a tray, the flange top). Negative draft means it points against the pull (the outside walls of a tray, the bottom); the sign is asin(n · pull), not which mould half forms the face. A planar stamped face takes one angle for the whole face, and a wall drafted at exactly the threshold passes (0.01° tolerance). threshold is degrees in (0, 90]; the pane offers 0.5, 1, 2, 3, and 5, and 1 is the default. A face at or above the threshold is positive when the sign is positive, and negative when the sign is negative. Tops and bottoms are classified with the same three classes. Classified area is the whole mesh. Absolute draft below the threshold is below, and that bucket still splits positive and negative so a locked-steel check can see the sign. A vertical wall is below and its sign stays positive. There is no zero-draft class. Positive at or above the threshold uses the cavity colour. Negative at or above the threshold uses the core colour. Below the threshold is a red hatch. The result reports positive, negative, and below, each with count and area. below.positive and below.negative are the sign split. violations is the below count. Changing threshold rebuckets the stored field and does not measure the mesh again. on false removes the skin so face paint and the part colour show again. Omit on to toggle. Pass threshold without on to show at that threshold. Read-only. Not CAD draft mode, not an automatic draft fix, and not a quote. Molding rules: guide { topic: "molding" }. Long runs: an analysis still going after about 30 s answers { status: "running", stillRunning: true, jobId, command, phase?, percent?, elapsedSec, etaSec? } instead of the result. That is a heartbeat, not the result. Call mold_status { job_id } (it waits up to about 30 s each time) until it answers the result; the analysis keeps running in the tab and is not restarted.

on.description: true shows signed mold draft. false restores paint and the part colour. Omit to toggle. Pass threshold without on to show at that threshold.

threshold.description: Draft threshold in degrees, greater than 0 and at most 90. The pane offers 0.5, 1, 2, 3, and 5. Default is 1. At or above this angle, positive draft is Positive ≥ T and negative draft is Negative ≥ T. Absolute draft below this angle is Below T, and the sign is still reported. Omit to keep the current threshold. A change rebuckets the stored field and does not measure the mesh again.
